Our job is to understand how sound travels in the ocean and what impact it has on marine life. Our
staff—comprised of field workers, engineers, technicians, analysts, acoustic modellers, and
biologists — work together to provide effective solutions to client requirements.

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.

instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.

###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization

(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

[newsImage]

Cole-Parmer SamplePrep Demo Program

Posted: 1 / 9 / 2025

We understand that choosing the right sample preparation equipment and methods can be challenging.
That’s why we offer complimentary sample testing services to help you ensure that your samples are
processed using the most effective techniques.

Our dedicated team of experts and our new demo laboratory are here to assist you in determining the
best sample preparation solution for your specific needs.

Our demo lab is equipped with fully operational operational homogenizers (bead beaters), cryogenic
mills, high-energy ball mills, ring and puck mills, and XRF pellet presses enabling us to process
virtually any sample type. It's easy to set up a visit either virtually or in person where you can
watch these instruments process the material of your choice.

We offer 3 options for sample processing:

• Send in your sample: physical testing of your sample with shared results
• Virtual sample processing: virtual demonstration of the equipment and sample processing
• Visit our facility: see your sample processing in action

To request sample processing, [complete the form][95] and include it with your sample.

After completing the sample processing form, please be sure to schedule your sample processing with
a member from our team. Email us at [sampleprep@coleparmer.com][96] or contact +1.732.623.00465.

[newsImage]

Cole-Parmer SamplePrep Demo Program

Posted: 1 / 9 / 2025

We understand that choosing the right sample preparation equipment and methods can be challenging.
That’s why we offer complimentary sample testing services to help you ensure that your samples are
processed using the most effective techniques.

Our dedicated team of experts and our new demo laboratory are here to assist you in determining the
best sample preparation solution for your specific needs.

Our demo lab is equipped with fully operational operational homogenizers (bead beaters), cryogenic
mills, high-energy ball mills, ring and puck mills, and XRF pellet presses enabling us to process
virtually any sample type. It's easy to set up a visit either virtually or in person where you can
watch these instruments process the material of your choice.

We offer 3 options for sample processing:

• Send in your sample: physical testing of your sample with shared results
• Virtual sample processing: virtual demonstration of the equipment and sample processing
• Visit our facility: see your sample processing in action

To request sample processing, [complete the form][95] and include it with your sample.

After completing the sample processing form, please be sure to schedule your sample processing with
a member from our team. Email us at [sampleprep@coleparmer.com][96] or contact +1.732.623.00465.

Our trainers and consultants are members of the [Royal Society of Chemistry (RSC)][309] and are
current practitioners in the field of Analytical Chemistry. Many of our training courses have been
approved by the [Royal Society of Chemistry][310] for purposes of Continuing Professional
Development (CPD).

## Anthias Consulting Ltd are experts in the analytical science fields of...
* [ **Data analysis ** (chemometrics, metabolomics) ][311]
* [ ** Methods ** (method validation, method development) ][312]
* [ ** Sample preparation ** (LLE, SPE, SPME, HS, TD, Py, P&T) ][313]
* [ ** Elemental analysis ** (AAS, ICP-OES, AES, ICP-MS) ][314]
* [ **Gas Chromatography** (GC, GC+GC, GCxGC) ][315]
* [ **GC-MS** (GC-SQMS, GC-QQQMS, GC-ITMS, GC-QTOFMS) ][316]
* [ **Liquid Chromatography** (HPLC, UHPLC, LCxLC, IC, SEC) ][317]
* [ **LC-MS** (LC-SQMS, LC-QQQMS, LC-QTOFMS, LC-ITMS) ][318]
* [ ** Molecular spectroscopy ** (FTIR, NIR, UV-Vis) ][319]
* [ ** Molecular imaging ** (MSI, MALDI-TOF, DESI-MS, IMS-MS) ][320]
* [ ** Structural & particle size analysis ** (PXRD, LDA, XRF) ][321]
* [ **Thermal analysis** (DSC, TGA, EGA) ][322]
* [ ** Water content analysis ** (KF, IR moisture, digital moisture) ][323]

Our trainers and consultants are members of the [Royal Society of Chemistry (RSC)][309] and are
current practitioners in the field of Analytical Chemistry. Many of our training courses have been
approved by the [Royal Society of Chemistry][310] for purposes of Continuing Professional
Development (CPD).

## Anthias Consulting Ltd are experts in the analytical science fields of...
* [ **Data analysis ** (chemometrics, metabolomics) ][311]
* [ ** Methods ** (method validation, method development) ][312]
* [ ** Sample preparation ** (LLE, SPE, SPME, HS, TD, Py, P&T) ][313]
* [ ** Elemental analysis ** (AAS, ICP-OES, AES, ICP-MS) ][314]
* [ **Gas Chromatography** (GC, GC+GC, GCxGC) ][315]
* [ **GC-MS** (GC-SQMS, GC-QQQMS, GC-ITMS, GC-QTOFMS) ][316]
* [ **Liquid Chromatography** (HPLC, UHPLC, LCxLC, IC, SEC) ][317]
* [ **LC-MS** (LC-SQMS, LC-QQQMS, LC-QTOFMS, LC-ITMS) ][318]
* [ ** Molecular spectroscopy ** (FTIR, NIR, UV-Vis) ][319]
* [ ** Molecular imaging ** (MSI, MALDI-TOF, DESI-MS, IMS-MS) ][320]
* [ ** Structural & particle size analysis ** (PXRD, LDA, XRF) ][321]
* [ **Thermal analysis** (DSC, TGA, EGA) ][322]
* [ ** Water content analysis ** (KF, IR moisture, digital moisture) ][323]

# Graduations

## Congratulations to all of our students graduating this summer.

[ Find out more about graduation ceremonies ][18]

# Summer 2026 graduations are here

## Celebrate your achievements

Now your studies are complete, it’s time to celebrate everything you've achieved with your loved
ones in the magnificent surroundings of Bath Abbey.

It's a moment to reflect on your university experience, look ahead to the future, and receive the
award you've worked so hard for.

## Raise a glass at your graduation reception

After the ceremony, join your department’s drinks reception to celebrate with friends, family,
tutors, and other University staff who have supported you throughout your studies.

## Hot weather forecast during graduations

Bath Abbey will be hot during the graduation ceremonies.

To help yourself keep cool, please bring:
* your own water bottle - we're not able to provide drinking water in the Abbey
* a handheld fan

You don't need to wear a suit jacket during the ceremonies, but you should wear light and breathable
clothing under your gown.

# Graduations

## Congratulations to all of our students graduating this summer.

[ Find out more about graduation ceremonies ][18]

# Summer 2026 graduations are here

## Celebrate your achievements

Now your studies are complete, it’s time to celebrate everything you've achieved with your loved
ones in the magnificent surroundings of Bath Abbey.

It's a moment to reflect on your university experience, look ahead to the future, and receive the
award you've worked so hard for.

## Raise a glass at your graduation reception

After the ceremony, join your department’s drinks reception to celebrate with friends, family,
tutors, and other University staff who have supported you throughout your studies.

## Hot weather forecast during graduations

Bath Abbey will be hot during the graduation ceremonies.

To help yourself keep cool, please bring:
* your own water bottle - we're not able to provide drinking water in the Abbey
* a handheld fan

You don't need to wear a suit jacket during the ceremonies, but you should wear light and breathable
clothing under your gown.

# ChemCalc - Molecular Formula Calculator

ChemCalc is a free online tool for mass spectrometry. Calculate molecular weight, monoisotopic mass,
and isotopic distribution from a molecular formula. Find possible molecular formulas from a
monoisotopic mass. Analyze peptide, nucleotide, and polymer fragmentation.

Please enable JavaScript to use the interactive application.

Reference: Patiny L, Borel A. ChemCalc: a building block for tomorrow's chemical infrastructure. J
Chem Inf Model. 2013. DOI: 10.1021/ci300563h

# Molecular formula calculator

Calculate molecular weight, monoisotopic mass, elemental composition, and isotopic distribution from
any molecular formula. Supports groups, charges, salts, and isotope-specific notation for mass
spectrometry.

Do I have to pay to access the notes?

platform. You don’t have to pay to access those. However, to access and enjoy the full content, you
have to subscribe. You may choose to subscribe for 1 month, 3 months, 6 months or one year,
depending on your goals.

How do I enroll?

subject from the class. You will see ENROLL NOW at the top of the subject, click on it. Choose your
preferred Subscription Package (1 Month, 3 Months, 6 Months or 12 Months), select your payment
option (Direct Transfer or Card Payment), then follow the prompts to complete the process. It’s that
simple.

Does ClassNotes.ng monitor students?

The platform designed to spur you on to study effectively, complete your notes and attempt the quiz
successfully. You can also track your progress from your dashboard by yourself, and challenge
yourself to do more.

Does ClassNotes.ng give assignments, marks, and grade students?

We have evaluation questions in most of the notes. These questions can be used to test how well
students understand completed notes for superior academic achievement.

How much does ClassNotes.ng cost?

We have a variety of plans to suit your learning goals. We have four Unique Subscription Plans which
includes Monthly ₦999 ($2.29), Quarterly ₦2499 ($6.99), Biannual ₦4999 ($13.99), Annual ₦9999
($26.99) only.

Is ₦999 for a subject or class?

The ₦999 subscription for one-month grants you access to all subjects, topics, and content for your
chosen class, for a period of one month.

How do I pay for ClassNotes.ng?

Before payment, you have to register in your choice class. Afterwards, you can pay using your Card
or Direct Bank Transfer [To Afrilearn 0538617241 GTBank]. Either option still requires that your
first enroll in your class of choice before making payment. (See answer on how to enroll above, for
guidance).

What certificate will I be awarded?

For now, ClassNotes.ng does not offer certificates. We are a supplementary learning service for
schools and exam institutions that offer certificates. We help you prepare well to excel in school,
excel in life and earn any certificate you desire.

Can more than one children use the same account?

Yes, this is possible. It’s easier if they are in the same class. However, if they are not, you can
enroll into two subjects or more with the same account but you are required to pay for each class
you enroll into. We recommend that each child have a different account though so as to personalise
their learning, track their progress and be eligible for other features only registered accounts on
the platform can qualify for.

Can we get added to ClassNotes.ng's Whatsapp forum?

Students can only interact through the comment segment of each topic for now. We are currently
working on integrating a more participatory forum for students.

How much is a year subscription?

One yearly subscription is *₦9999 only.*

I have paid using 'Direct Transfer' but it's still saying 'you are yet to enroll'?

When you make payment and send your payment details, the team enrolls you manually. If you cannot
access the class you paid for, it is because you are not LOGGED IN. Every time you use the platform,
you should log in with your registered email and password to access your dashboard where your
courses are. Once you sign in, you will be able to access all the content in the class paid for.

Can I ask questions about classes here?

Comments are activated under each topic for you to place your questions such that a fellow student
can contribute or a ClassNotes.ng tutor/representative can provide clarity.

How does ClassNotes.ng work? Registering for your kids?

The platform is pre-stored with curriculum-relevant and trusted content, created by experts, for all
classes. Same, if not more than they would get in a physical classroom. Each class is seamlessly
classified into First Term, Second Term and Third Term covering all topics in the curriculum. The
student can study at their time from anywhere. We have created a timetable for both Junior Secondary
and Senior Secondary that students can adopt in their personal study. There is a plain template of
the timetable that you can download and recreate as you like with your children as well. Find it on
the Resources page.

Can I view the notes offline if I've paid for the lessons?

The classes content are not downloadable because they undergo frequent editing and update to meet
curriculum standard at all times and to provide more clarity. However, the platform is built in a
way that it consumes less data and you can access the content subscribed for at any time from
anywhere.

I’m not too techy; can you help me with my registration process?

Our support team can enroll you into your class and provide you with access details upon payment
confirmation and receipt of your registration details (Name, Email, Phone Number, Location).

Can an adult learner go through secondary school using ClassNotes.ng?

Yes. The platform is pre-stored with all content needed for all classes. Same, if not more than they
would get in a physical classroom. Each class is broken down into First Term, Second Term, and Third
Term covering all topics in the curriculum. We have a timetable you can follow or adapt to suit your
free time for personal study.

Can I get a refund after subscription?

ClassNotes.ng does not offer refund after payment have been made whether one time or through
automatic renewal. If you do not want to be renewed, you can simply turn off the Auto Renew feature
in your account before the end of the subscription length.

Can I Cancel my Subscription?

Yes you can. To cancel your subscription at any time. Kindly go to classnotes.ng/my-account to
select My Subscription and you can cancel from there.

How Can I Stop Auto Renewal on My Card?

Your card is automatically debited at the end of your current subscription except you stop the auto
renew. To do that go to classnotes.ng/my-account, select My Subscription and turn off the Auto Renew
feature.

option (Direct Transfer or Card Payment), then follow the prompts to complete the process. It’s that
simple.

Does ClassNotes.ng monitor students?

The platform designed to spur you on to study effectively, complete your notes and attempt the quiz
successfully. You can also track your progress from your dashboard by yourself, and challenge
yourself to do more.

Does ClassNotes.ng give assignments, marks, and grade students?

We have evaluation questions in most of the notes. These questions can be used to test how well
students understand completed notes for superior academic achievement.

How much does ClassNotes.ng cost?

We have a variety of plans to suit your learning goals. We have four Unique Subscription Plans which
includes Monthly ₦999 ($2.29), Quarterly ₦2499 ($6.99), Biannual ₦4999 ($13.99), Annual ₦9999
($26.99) only.

Is ₦999 for a subject or class?

The ₦999 subscription for one-month grants you access to all subjects, topics, and content for your
chosen class, for a period of one month.

How do I pay for ClassNotes.ng?

Before payment, you have to register in your choice class. Afterwards, you can pay using your Card
or Direct Bank Transfer [To Afrilearn 0538617241 GTBank]. Either option still requires that your
first enroll in your class of choice before making payment. (See answer on how to enroll above, for
guidance).

What certificate will I be awarded?

For now, ClassNotes.ng does not offer certificates. We are a supplementary learning service for
schools and exam institutions that offer certificates. We help you prepare well to excel in school,
excel in life and earn any certificate you desire.

Can more than one children use the same account?

Yes, this is possible. It’s easier if they are in the same class. However, if they are not, you can
enroll into two subjects or more with the same account but you are required to pay for each class
you enroll into. We recommend that each child have a different account though so as to personalise
their learning, track their progress and be eligible for other features only registered accounts on
the platform can qualify for.

Can we get added to ClassNotes.ng's Whatsapp forum?

Students can only interact through the comment segment of each topic for now. We are currently
working on integrating a more participatory forum for students.

How much is a year subscription?

One yearly subscription is *₦9999 only.*

I have paid using 'Direct Transfer' but it's still saying 'you are yet to enroll'?

When you make payment and send your payment details, the team enrolls you manually. If you cannot
access the class you paid for, it is because you are not LOGGED IN. Every time you use the platform,
you should log in with your registered email and password to access your dashboard where your
courses are. Once you sign in, you will be able to access all the content in the class paid for.

Can I ask questions about classes here?

Comments are activated under each topic for you to place your questions such that a fellow student
can contribute or a ClassNotes.ng tutor/representative can provide clarity.

How does ClassNotes.ng work? Registering for your kids?

The platform is pre-stored with curriculum-relevant and trusted content, created by experts, for all
classes. Same, if not more than they would get in a physical classroom. Each class is seamlessly
classified into First Term, Second Term and Third Term covering all topics in the curriculum. The
student can study at their time from anywhere. We have created a timetable for both Junior Secondary
and Senior Secondary that students can adopt in their personal study. There is a plain template of
the timetable that you can download and recreate as you like with your children as well. Find it on
the Resources page.

Can I view the notes offline if I've paid for the lessons?

The classes content are not downloadable because they undergo frequent editing and update to meet
curriculum standard at all times and to provide more clarity. However, the platform is built in a
way that it consumes less data and you can access the content subscribed for at any time from
anywhere.

I’m not too techy; can you help me with my registration process?

Our support team can enroll you into your class and provide you with access details upon payment
confirmation and receipt of your registration details (Name, Email, Phone Number, Location).

Can an adult learner go through secondary school using ClassNotes.ng?

Yes. The platform is pre-stored with all content needed for all classes. Same, if not more than they
would get in a physical classroom. Each class is broken down into First Term, Second Term, and Third
Term covering all topics in the curriculum. We have a timetable you can follow or adapt to suit your
free time for personal study.

Can I get a refund after subscription?

ClassNotes.ng does not offer refund after payment have been made whether one time or through
automatic renewal. If you do not want to be renewed, you can simply turn off the Auto Renew feature
in your account before the end of the subscription length.

Can I Cancel my Subscription?

Yes you can. To cancel your subscription at any time. Kindly go to classnotes.ng/my-account to
select My Subscription and you can cancel from there.

How Can I Stop Auto Renewal on My Card?

Your card is automatically debited at the end of your current subscription except you stop the auto
renew. To do that go to classnotes.ng/my-account, select My Subscription and turn off the Auto Renew
feature.

# Molecular Spectroscopy Laboratory

## Dr. Dheeraj Kumar Singh's Research Group

Welcome to our research Group Here you can track Our latest work in different Fields

## Research

Our research group is a part of the Physics Department of  Institute of Infrastructure Technology
Research and Management, Ahmedabad (An Autonomous University established by Government of Gujrat).
Our research interests are mainly focused to explore various kinds of Chemical Physics, Spectroscopy
and Materials Science. We have both experimental and theoretical wings:

In the experimental section, we focus on:
1. Vibrational Spectroscopy of Ionic Liquids Materials
2. Spectroscopic investigation on molecular association such as; hydrogen bonds and other weak
   interaction
3. Molecular interactions with nanoparticles surfaces at the air-water interface

In the theoretical section our research interests include:
1. Ab initio and DFT calculations.
2. Classical and Quantum Molecular dynamics simulation
3. 2D Correlation spectroscopy and Multivariate Data Analysis.

We are deeply indebted to the Department of Science & Technology, Govt. of India (DST, New Delhi),
for funding the research projects.Research project one from DST-SERB ( ECR/2016/001289 ; Total
Outlay : INR 48 LAKH ) is in operation.

Can reach me through either of the following emails:

[dheerajsingh@iitram.ac.in/][21] [dheerajsingh84@gmail.com][22]

functioning from first week of September 2018.

# Molecular Spectroscopy Laboratory

## Dr. Dheeraj Kumar Singh's Research Group

Welcome to our research Group Here you can track Our latest work in different Fields

## Research

Our research group is a part of the Physics Department of  Institute of Infrastructure Technology
Research and Management, Ahmedabad (An Autonomous University established by Government of Gujrat).
Our research interests are mainly focused to explore various kinds of Chemical Physics, Spectroscopy
and Materials Science. We have both experimental and theoretical wings:

In the experimental section, we focus on:
1. Vibrational Spectroscopy of Ionic Liquids Materials
2. Spectroscopic investigation on molecular association such as; hydrogen bonds and other weak
   interaction
3. Molecular interactions with nanoparticles surfaces at the air-water interface

In the theoretical section our research interests include:
1. Ab initio and DFT calculations.
2. Classical and Quantum Molecular dynamics simulation
3. 2D Correlation spectroscopy and Multivariate Data Analysis.

We are deeply indebted to the Department of Science & Technology, Govt. of India (DST, New Delhi),
for funding the research projects.Research project one from DST-SERB ( ECR/2016/001289 ; Total
Outlay : INR 48 LAKH ) is in operation.

# Implen UV-Vis Spectrophotometers for
# DNA, RNA, Protein & Cell Analysis

**UV/Vis spectroscopy is at the heart of countless scientific discoveries.**

**At Implen, it’s the foundation of everything we do.**

Our mission extends beyond building instruments. We design and manufacture high-performance UV/Vis
solutions that empower researchers to understand their measurements, solve real laboratory
challenges, and generate data they can trust through innovative technology, scientific expertise,
and ongoing education.

## Precision UV-Vis Quality Control, Engineered for Scientists

For more than 20 years, Implen has helped researchers and laboratory professionals around the world
maintain high standards through precise UV-Vis spectroscopy. Our philosophy is simple: instruments
should be accurate, fast, and dependable, especially when quality control decisions rely on them.
Scientists use UV/Vis spectroscopy every day to confirm DNA and RNA purity before downstream
applications, quantify proteins with confidence, monitor cell growth, and ensure consistency across
samples and experiments.

Reliable quality control helps prevent costly errors, protects valuable samples, and improves
efficiency throughout the laboratory workflow.

That’s why Implen instruments are designed to deliver trustworthy data without unnecessary
complexity, allowing scientists to spend less time troubleshooting and more time discovering.

And remember: **absorbance increases with concentration**. Some laws of science are complicated.
Beer-Lambert isn’t one of them.

[Read more][82] 08 July 2024 ##### IntechOpen Presents Interviews for Young Scientists with Science's Leading Minds We are pleased to present a series of inspirational interviews for young researchers with some of today's leading scientists, ranging from a Nobel laureate to pioneers and innovators in various fields, including pharmacogenomics, pharmaceutical leadership, and academia. [Read more][83] 22 May 2024 ##### IntechOpen Reaches New Milestone: 7,000 Books Open for All IntechOpen has achieved a significant milestone in its mission to democratise scientific knowledge by announcing the publication of its 7,000th open access book, 'Towards the Eradication of* Helicobacter pylori* Infection - Rapid Diagnosis and Precision Treatment.' Guided by the expertise of Dr Liang Wang, Dr Alfred Chin Yen Tay, and 2005 Nobel Prize Laureate Prof. Barry J. Marshall, this book offers insightful research and novel approaches, contributing to the continuous discourse on *Helicobacter pylori*-related research. [Read more][84] 11 March 2024 ##### IntechOpen Signs Open Access Institutional Agreement with Iowa State University IntechOpen signs an institutional agreement with Iowa State University of Science and Technology to support open access and cover open access publishing fees for their faculty. [Read more][85] 07 June 2023 ##### IntechOpen Becomes a UKSG Member IntechOpen is now an official member of the UKSG, the UK's largest scholarly communications community. Founded almost half a century ago, it connects the knowledge community and encourages the exchange of ideas in scholarly communication. [Read more][86] 28 March 2023 ##### IntechOpen Book Wins the 2022 International Academy of Astronautics Life Science Book Award We are thrilled that the International Academy of Astronautics has chosen IntechOpen's book "Preparation of Space Experiments", edited by Dr. Vladimir Pletser, to receive the IAA Life Science Book Award. The award is given annually to recognize excellence in publication by an Academy member or corresponding member in the field of life sciences. ## Integration for Academic Excellence

Supporting academic excellence through lifetime instrument training, expert guidance, and
curriculum-aligned learning experiences.

[Learn More][75]

## CD User Group 2026

This collaborative group provides an opportunity to exchange best practices, discuss troubleshooting
strategies, and explore advanced applications of CD technology.

[Read the Full Story][76]

## Explore the latest innovations in Molecular Spectroscopy and HPLC
* [ [J-1100 Circular Dichroism Spectrophotometer] ][77]
  
  ## Circular Dichroism Spectrophotometers
  
  The J-1100 is the most compact CD spectrometer, designed to save bench space without compromising
  performance. This simple yet powerful design is perfect for users looking to make routine CD
  measurements in both academia & industry.
  
  [Find out more about the J-1100][78]
* [ [LC 3] ][79]
  
  ## HPLC and UHPLC Systems
  
  LC-4000 series HPLC and LC-MS systems for conventional HPLC (up to 500 bar), RHPLC (up to 700
  bar), and UHPLC (up to 1300 bar).
  
  [Find out more about the LC-4000 Series][80]
* ## Digital Polarimeters
  
  Consisting of three tailored models—including LED, sodium lamp, and multi-wavelength
  configurations—the P-4000 Series delivers stable, highly accurate measurements, intuitive
  operation, and robust compliance with regulatory standards.
  
  [Explore the P-4000 series][81]
* ## Confocal Raman Microscope
  
  The NRS-5500 features a spectroscope with a 300 mm focal length, engineered to provide an optimal
  balance between signal-to-noise ratio and spectral resolution.
  
  [Find out more about confocal Raman microscopy][82]
* ## FTIR Microscopes
  
  The X-Series of FTIR Microscopes provide high-resolution chemical imaging and precise
  microanalysis through advanced optics and intuitive automation.
  
  [Explore FTIR Microscopy][83]
* ## PR-1w Palmtop Raman Spectrometer
  
  The PR-1w Palmtop Raman spectrometer is a handheld-sized Raman spectrometer that contains a 785 nm
  laser, spectrometer, and detector in a compact housing.
  
  [Palmtop Handheld Raman][84]
* ## FT/IR 8X Spectrometer
  
  FT/IR-8X is JASCO’s most advanced FTIR spectrometer with a highly configurable optical system that
  applies to virtually any FTIR application.
  
  [Learn more about the FT/IR-8X][85]

## Integration for Academic Excellence

Supporting academic excellence through lifetime instrument training, expert guidance, and
curriculum-aligned learning experiences.

[Learn More][75]

## CD User Group 2026

This collaborative group provides an opportunity to exchange best practices, discuss troubleshooting
strategies, and explore advanced applications of CD technology.

[Read the Full Story][76]

## Explore the latest innovations in Molecular Spectroscopy and HPLC
* [ [J-1100 Circular Dichroism Spectrophotometer] ][77]
  
  ## Circular Dichroism Spectrophotometers
  
  The J-1100 is the most compact CD spectrometer, designed to save bench space without compromising
  performance. This simple yet powerful design is perfect for users looking to make routine CD
  measurements in both academia & industry.
  
  [Find out more about the J-1100][78]
* [ [LC 3] ][79]
  
  ## HPLC and UHPLC Systems
  
  LC-4000 series HPLC and LC-MS systems for conventional HPLC (up to 500 bar), RHPLC (up to 700
  bar), and UHPLC (up to 1300 bar).
  
  [Find out more about the LC-4000 Series][80]
* ## Digital Polarimeters
  
  Consisting of three tailored models—including LED, sodium lamp, and multi-wavelength
  configurations—the P-4000 Series delivers stable, highly accurate measurements, intuitive
  operation, and robust compliance with regulatory standards.
  
  [Explore the P-4000 series][81]
* ## Confocal Raman Microscope
  
  The NRS-5500 features a spectroscope with a 300 mm focal length, engineered to provide an optimal
  balance between signal-to-noise ratio and spectral resolution.
  
  [Find out more about confocal Raman microscopy][82]
* ## FTIR Microscopes
  
  The X-Series of FTIR Microscopes provide high-resolution chemical imaging and precise
  microanalysis through advanced optics and intuitive automation.
  
  [Explore FTIR Microscopy][83]
* ## PR-1w Palmtop Raman Spectrometer
  
  The PR-1w Palmtop Raman spectrometer is a handheld-sized Raman spectrometer that contains a 785 nm
  laser, spectrometer, and detector in a compact housing.
  
  [Palmtop Handheld Raman][84]
* ## FT/IR 8X Spectrometer
  
  FT/IR-8X is JASCO’s most advanced FTIR spectrometer with a highly configurable optical system that
  applies to virtually any FTIR application.
  
  [Learn more about the FT/IR-8X][85]

### Designed in Tokyo. **TRUSTED** globally.

[View our support plans][86]

## About US

LAXMI ANALYTICAL LABORATORIES is an Analytical Service provider, provides complete Instrumentation,
Chemical & Microbiological Testing services to the clients. As a service provider, we offer services
for Pigment Analysis, Textile Analysis, Plastic & Polymer Analysis, Coal Analysis, Fertilizer & Soil
Analysis, Soaps & Detergent Analysis and Environmental/Water Analysis & Flavors, Fragrance,
Essential Oil & Perfume Analysis. Along with these services, we also offer services for Vegetable
Oil & Fats Analysis, Petroleum Products & Fuel Analysis, Mineral & Ores Analysis, Metal & Metal
Alloy Analysis, Electric Components Analysis, etc.

E-Brochure

[ Read More][133]

## Company Profile

Based in Mumbai (India), we, LAXMI ANALYTICAL LABORATORIES, are an Analytical Service Provider,
offering analytical solutions to the customers. We are counted among the reliable service providers
in this sphere. Our services range includes Speciality chemicals analysis, Dyes & Pigment analysis,
Water Analysis, Metal Analysis, Essential Oil & Perfume Analysis, Plastic & Polymer Analysis,
Textile Analysis, Coal Analysis, Soaps & Detergent Analysis, Fertilizer & Soil Analysis and much
more. Each of these services is provided by considering client's budget limitations and specific
needs.

## About US

LAXMI ANALYTICAL LABORATORIES is an Analytical Service provider, provides complete Instrumentation,
Chemical & Microbiological Testing services to the clients. As a service provider, we offer services
for Pigment Analysis, Textile Analysis, Plastic & Polymer Analysis, Coal Analysis, Fertilizer & Soil
Analysis, Soaps & Detergent Analysis and Environmental/Water Analysis & Flavors, Fragrance,
Essential Oil & Perfume Analysis. Along with these services, we also offer services for Vegetable
Oil & Fats Analysis, Petroleum Products & Fuel Analysis, Mineral & Ores Analysis, Metal & Metal
Alloy Analysis, Electric Components Analysis, etc.

## Company Profile

Based in Mumbai (India), we, LAXMI ANALYTICAL LABORATORIES, are an Analytical Service Provider,
offering analytical solutions to the customers. We are counted among the reliable service providers
in this sphere. Our services range includes Speciality chemicals analysis, Dyes & Pigment analysis,
Water Analysis, Metal Analysis, Essential Oil & Perfume Analysis, Plastic & Polymer Analysis,
Textile Analysis, Coal Analysis, Soaps & Detergent Analysis, Fertilizer & Soil Analysis and much
more. Each of these services is provided by considering client's budget limitations and specific
needs.

Your needs are always our priority. We will accommodate your criteria for turnaround times,

in compliance with Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP). We are

R&D projects. This is how our service works in practice:

1. Tell us about your testing needs

2. Our experts will help you select the right tests and create a testing plan

3. You will receive an offer and can order the tests through our easy-to-use customer portal

4. Ship your samples to one of our sample reception hubs

5. We will test your samples and issue a report

6. Our experts are available to help interpret the results or plan next steps

virology, parasitology, mycology, immunology, molecular biology, biochemistry, computational

Welcome to Western’s Department of Physics and Astronomy, where we passionately pursue knowledge
about the fundamental laws that govern the Universe and all that it contains. Our interdisciplinary
research investigates how matter, forces, and energy interact and shape objects and environments,
from our own direct surroundings here on Earth to the event horizon of black holes in the distant
reaches of the Universe. We are as curious about the practical applications of physics to medicine
and the environment as the fascinating physics behind the largest structures in the cosmos!

We bring that passion and curiosity into our student experience. Our students are an essential part
of our community, and often key contributors to our research. We are dedicated to helping students
and young investigators discover their potential by giving them guidance and support to become
better scientists, community members, and people. We are excited to work with you at all stages of
your career, to help develop your interests and achieve your goals.

[ Discover Cronyn ][41]              [ Upcoming Events ][42]              [ Our Outreach ][43]

### News
* ### [Do super-Jupiters look like Jupiter? Not necessarily, study shows][44]
  
  By Jeff Renaud, Western News, December 01, 2025
  
  
  Using images from the James Webb Space Telescope (Webb), an international research team including
  Western’s Stanimir Metchev has discovered new answers to explain how some brown dwarfs form giant
  dust storms, contradicting previous assumptions.
  
  [Read the full article][45]
* ### [Helping decode chemistry behind cosmic butterfly’s beauty][46]
  
  By Jeff Renaud, Western News, August 27, 2025
  
  
  James Webb Space Telescope reveals unexpected molecules that unlock secrets of stellar evolution
  
  [Read the full article][47]
* ### [Meteor cameras to tackle aviation-induced climate change][48]
  
  By Jeff Renaud, Western News, August 11, 2025
  
  
  Physics and astronomy professor Denis Vida and his team are expanding the Global Meteor Network to
  track aircraft contrails. With support from Breakthrough Energy and Google, they aim to help
  reroute flights to prevent contrail formations, providing a low-cost way to reduce aviation
  emissions.
  
  [Read the full article][49]
* ### [Western astrophysicists predict origins of unexpected space objects][50]
  
  By Jeff Renaud, Western News, March 06, 2025
  
  
  Physics and astronomy professor Paul Wiegert and PhD candidate Cole Gregg developed a computer
  model to study the possibility that interstellar material discovered in our solar system
  originates from the solar system next door, Alpha Centauri.
  
  [Read the full article][51]
* ### [Team of Western students wins NASA Space Apps Challenge][52]
  
  By Colleen MacDonald, Western News, January 17, 2025
  
  
  A Western team of graduate students, Ian Chow, Simon Van Schuylenbergh, Maximilian Vovk and Dakota
  Cecil, won the Best Use of Science Award in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. At the annual hackathon
  held in cities across the world, coders and innovators devise solutions to the pressing challenges
  humanity faces, both on Earth and in space.
  
  [Read the full article][53]
* ### [Physics & Astronomy Graduate Students win NASA Space Apps Challenge Regional Competition][54]
  
  By Western Space, LinkedIn, October 08, 2024
  
  
  Congratulations to graduate students Maximilian Vovk, Ian Chow, Dakota Cecil, and Simon Van
  Schuylenbergh of Physics & Astronomy on their win of the NASA Space Apps Challenge regional
  competition in Waterloo! The team developed an interactive web app that highlights risky
  Near-Earth Objects (NEOs) to identify potential threats to Earth, while meteor streams and
  sporadics are used to map risk zones for satellites.
  
  [Read the full article][55]
* ### [Introduction to CubeSat Technology at Cronyn Observatory][56]

Welcome to Western’s Department of Physics and Astronomy, where we passionately pursue knowledge
about the fundamental laws that govern the Universe and all that it contains. Our interdisciplinary
research investigates how matter, forces, and energy interact and shape objects and environments,
from our own direct surroundings here on Earth to the event horizon of black holes in the distant
reaches of the Universe. We are as curious about the practical applications of physics to medicine
and the environment as the fascinating physics behind the largest structures in the cosmos!

We bring that passion and curiosity into our student experience. Our students are an essential part
of our community, and often key contributors to our research. We are dedicated to helping students
and young investigators discover their potential by giving them guidance and support to become
better scientists, community members, and people. We are excited to work with you at all stages of
your career, to help develop your interests and achieve your goals.

[ Discover Cronyn ][41]              [ Upcoming Events ][42]              [ Our Outreach ][43]

### News
* ### [Do super-Jupiters look like Jupiter? Not necessarily, study shows][44]
  
  By Jeff Renaud, Western News, December 01, 2025
  
  
  Using images from the James Webb Space Telescope (Webb), an international research team including
  Western’s Stanimir Metchev has discovered new answers to explain how some brown dwarfs form giant
  dust storms, contradicting previous assumptions.
  
  [Read the full article][45]
* ### [Helping decode chemistry behind cosmic butterfly’s beauty][46]
  
  By Jeff Renaud, Western News, August 27, 2025
  
  
  James Webb Space Telescope reveals unexpected molecules that unlock secrets of stellar evolution
  
  [Read the full article][47]
* ### [Meteor cameras to tackle aviation-induced climate change][48]
  
  By Jeff Renaud, Western News, August 11, 2025
  
  
  Physics and astronomy professor Denis Vida and his team are expanding the Global Meteor Network to
  track aircraft contrails. With support from Breakthrough Energy and Google, they aim to help
  reroute flights to prevent contrail formations, providing a low-cost way to reduce aviation
  emissions.
  
  [Read the full article][49]
* ### [Western astrophysicists predict origins of unexpected space objects][50]
  
  By Jeff Renaud, Western News, March 06, 2025
  
  
  Physics and astronomy professor Paul Wiegert and PhD candidate Cole Gregg developed a computer
  model to study the possibility that interstellar material discovered in our solar system
  originates from the solar system next door, Alpha Centauri.
  
  [Read the full article][51]
* ### [Team of Western students wins NASA Space Apps Challenge][52]
  
  By Colleen MacDonald, Western News, January 17, 2025
  
  
  A Western team of graduate students, Ian Chow, Simon Van Schuylenbergh, Maximilian Vovk and Dakota
  Cecil, won the Best Use of Science Award in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. At the annual hackathon
  held in cities across the world, coders and innovators devise solutions to the pressing challenges
  humanity faces, both on Earth and in space.
  
  [Read the full article][53]
* ### [Physics & Astronomy Graduate Students win NASA Space Apps Challenge Regional Competition][54]
  
  By Western Space, LinkedIn, October 08, 2024
  
  
  Congratulations to graduate students Maximilian Vovk, Ian Chow, Dakota Cecil, and Simon Van
  Schuylenbergh of Physics & Astronomy on their win of the NASA Space Apps Challenge regional
  competition in Waterloo! The team developed an interactive web app that highlights risky
  Near-Earth Objects (NEOs) to identify potential threats to Earth, while meteor streams and
  sporadics are used to map risk zones for satellites.
  
  [Read the full article][55]
* ### [Introduction to CubeSat Technology at Cronyn Observatory][56]
  
  By Cronyn Observat

Psiberg is a virtual campus for all things science. We provide global education in the latest
scientific concepts, including but not limited to quantum mechanics.

Our way of teaching science simplifies concepts for students. We aim to eliminate the traditional
rote memorization and provide students with topics in a unique way to help them understand easily.

### We are on a mission to change the world of spectroscopic research

RamanBase is a web-based platform dedicated to managing and sharing Raman spectroscopic data.
Share your data with the world scientists, or create your own personal library.
We empower authors to unveil the full extent of their work to the world.
Crucially, RamanBase offers a range of innovative methods for searching spectra by various
attributes, including AI-based identification and sorting.
Identify spectra by similarity with our search engine.

## Shelyak instruments : experts en spectroscopie

Shelyak Instruments conçoit, fabrique et commercialise depuis plus de 10 ans une gamme complète de
spectroscopes dédiés à l’astronomie pour la Recherche, l’Industrie, l’Enseignement et les Loisirs.
Que vous soyez simple curieux ou observateur expérimenté, professionnel ou particulier, nous
fabriquons des instruments pour vous. Nous pouvons également adapter ces produits, voire même en
concevoir de nouveaux sur vos spécifications. Nous distribuons nos produits dans le monde entier,
directement par ce site web, et également au travers de notre réseau mondial de distributeurs.

Ce site vous donne toutes les informations techniques pour chaque instrument, mais également de
nombreuses informations sur les principes de la spectroscopie, des idées de projets à réaliser, des
informations de référence, etc. Fier d’être un acteur dynamique de la communauté grandissante des
spectrocopistes, nous voulons répondre toujours mieux à vos besoins. N’hésitez pas à nous contacter

## Shelyak instruments : experts en spectroscopie

Shelyak Instruments conçoit, fabrique et commercialise depuis plus de 10 ans une gamme complète de
spectroscopes dédiés à l’astronomie pour la Recherche, l’Industrie, l’Enseignement et les Loisirs.
Que vous soyez simple curieux ou observateur expérimenté, professionnel ou particulier, nous
fabriquons des instruments pour vous. Nous pouvons également adapter ces produits, voire même en
concevoir de nouveaux sur vos spécifications. Nous distribuons nos produits dans le monde entier,
directement par ce site web, et également au travers de notre réseau mondial de distributeurs.

Ce site vous donne toutes les informations techniques pour chaque instrument, mais également de
nombreuses informations sur les principes de la spectroscopie, des idées de projets à réaliser, des
informations de référence, etc. Fier d’être un acteur dynamique de la communauté grandissante des
spectrocopistes, nous voulons répondre toujours mieux à vos besoins. N’hésitez pas à nous contacter

Our Thematic & Disruption Research identifies the structural shifts, emerging technologies, new

guide strategy, investment, innovation, and organizational resilience.

## Strategic Revenue Advisory

Our Strategic Revenue Advisory helps organizations make confident, evidence-driven decisions about
where to focus, how to grow, and which capabilities matter most. We integrate market insight,

## Deliverables That Drive Revenue Decisions

Research outputs designed to plug directly into planning, investment and board level discussions.

### From Insight to Implementation

#### Data Collection

Structured gathering of market, customer, financial and competitive data from primary and secondary
sources.

#### Analytics and Modelling

Use of quantitative models and AI supported analysis to reveal patterns, stress points and leading
indicators.

#### Insight Development

Senior analysts translate findings into clear storylines and strategic implications.

#### Actionable Deliverables

Concrete recommendations, prioritised actions and quantified impact ranges.

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

### Informed Strategic Planning

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

### Stronger Investment and Portfolio Choices

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where
to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

### Faster, More Confident Execution

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

Our consultants are ready to support your next strategy cycle, investment decision or market entry
initiative with clear, evidence based insight.

## Industrial Automation

### High-precision electric/manual positioning stages play a crucial role in the field of industrial
### automation.

These positioning stages are designed to accurately move and position objects with precision and
repeatability, making them ideal for various applications in industries such as manufacturing,
robotics, semiconductor, and research.

[Aerospace]

Aerospace

## Aerospace

### Optics and Instrumentation

In the aerospace industry, optical systems and instrumentation demand exceptional precision.
Electric/manual positioning stages with high accuracy and repeatability are employed for aligning
optical elements, such lenses, mirrors, andisms. These stages allow engineers to achieve precise
angular and linear adjustments, ensuring optimal optical performance.

[View more][101]
[Metrology Testing Equipment]

Metrology Testing Equipment

## Metrology Testing Equipment

### Manufacturing Industry

In the manufacturing industry, metrology and measurement instruments are used for dimensional
inspection, calibration, and quality assurance. Coordinate measuring machines (CMMs) are employed to
measure the geometric features of complex parts, ensuring they meet design specifications.

[View more][102]
[Biological Science]

Biological Science

## Biological Science

### Microscopy

High-precision displacement stages play a crucial role in advanced microscopy techniques such as
confocal microscopy, super-resolution microscopy, and live-cell imaging. These stages allow
researchers to precisely position specimens and objectives, facilitating the acquisition of
high-resolution images with minimal motion artifacts.

## Aerospace

### Optics and Instrumentation

In the aerospace industry, optical systems and instrumentation demand exceptional precision.
Electric/manual positioning stages with high accuracy and repeatability are employed for aligning
optical elements, such lenses, mirrors, andisms. These stages allow engineers to achieve precise
angular and linear adjustments, ensuring optimal optical performance.

### Manufacturing Industry

In the manufacturing industry, metrology and measurement instruments are used for dimensional
inspection, calibration, and quality assurance. Coordinate measuring machines (CMMs) are employed to

## Biological Science

### Microscopy

High-precision displacement stages play a crucial role in advanced microscopy techniques such as
confocal microscopy, super-resolution microscopy, and live-cell imaging. These stages allow
researchers to precisely position specimens and objectives, facilitating the acquisition of
high-resolution images with minimal motion artifacts.
